title: AUTH-048 controlled visibility acquisition

assertionSteps.title: 1. Given User A is authenticated as user-a in an isolated browser context

steps.title: Install clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 07:59:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
Pause clock "Tue Jan 01 2030 08:00:00 GMT+0800 (Singapore Standard Time)"

assertionSteps.title: 2. And the selected fixture tab is labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page
3. And access A expires at controlled time T+900 seconds; no refresh credential exists
4. And the page is hidden; one hide-triggered acquisition request is pending
5. And request counts restart after the pending request began
6. When the browser delivers a hidden visibilitychange notification without changing visibility
7. And the browser delivers a second hidden visibilitychange notification without changing visibility
8. And the browser delivers a third hidden visibilitychange notification without changing visibility
9. Then the browser records exactly 0 new POST requests to "/api/auth/v2/sso/refreshtoken"
10. When the fixture accepts the original pending acquisition
11. And the browser changes this page from hidden to visible
12. Then the tab labelled "WS-A" inside the tablist named "workspaces" on the Home page is visible

steps.title: One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".
One visible workspace tab must have the exact name "WS-A".

assertionSteps.title: 13. And the installed refresh credential equals the original acquisition response credential

annotations.description: Actual MFE; controlled API responses, clock, visibility and suspension adapters. Unsigned browser-only credentials. No natural lifecycle, real identity or service policy acceptance.

limits: The recorded assertions and environment binding limit the supported business result.
